definitions.explanation: A common household insect pest known for its flat body, long antennae, and ability to survive in various conditions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台所|だいどころ}→台所：01021_daidokoro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ゴキブリ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I saw a cockroach in the kitchen.

examples.japanese: ゴキブリ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
ゴキブリ⟦{退治|たいじ}→退治：14314_taiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スプレー→スプレー：11581_supuree⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。

notes:
ゴキブリ is one of the most feared household pests in Japan, especially during the hot and humid summer months.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ゴキブリ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: cockroaches appear (in the house)
- ゴキブリ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{退治|たいじ}→退治：14314_taiji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to exterminate cockroaches
- ゴキブリ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: cockroach countermeasures
- ⟦ゴキブリホイホイ→ゴキブリホイホイ：noentry⟧: cockroach trap (brand name used generically)
- ゴキブリ⟦{駆除|くじょ}→駆除：16374_kujo⟧: cockroach extermination

CULTURAL NOTE:
Many Japanese people have a strong aversion to cockroaches. In casual speech and online, people often refer to them simply as "G" (ジー) to avoid saying the word directly.

SEASON:
Most commonly seen in ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧ (summer) when heat and humidity create ideal conditions. Prevention products sell strongly before summer begins.
